name: The Savoy
positioning: Historic Art Deco and Edwardian hotel on the Strand in London, officially Fairmont The Savoy, beside the Thames
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base within walking distance of Covent Garden and the West End
Families wanting a two-bedroom family room

facts.text: The Savoy is on the Strand in London (WC2R 0EZ).
The Savoy is London's first luxury hotel.
The hotel sits on the Waterloo Bridge bend of the Thames, with unobstructed views down both arms of the river, from the London Eye to Big Ben.
Covent Garden, Soho, St James's, Green Park and the West End theatres are within walking distance.
Rooms and suites are in Art Deco or Edwardian style.
Many rooms and suites have river views.
The One Bedroom River View Suite has an en-suite bathroom with a claw-foot bath and a separate sitting room.
The hotel has three Gordon Ramsay restaurants.
The hotel has a pool under an atrium roof, plus steam, sauna and a gym.
The Two Bedroom Family room suits families of three or four, with one bedroom with a king-size bed and the other with two double beds.

highlights.text: Monet painted his Views of the Thames series from one of the hotel's suites.
The American Bar is London's oldest surviving cocktail bar.
The hotel is home to the first electric lift, once known as the ascending room, which is still in use.
The Savoy Suite has a residential-style lounge with a fireplace and a private bar.
Children have their own check-in process, with homemade cookies and milk.

considerations.text: The hotel is renovating all of its bedrooms, with completion planned by 2027, so room finishes may differ.
Room rates exclude a discretionary service charge of 5%.
Parking is available for an additional fee.
